charge_port.notes: Estimated: The 2027 ES is a carry-over of the 2026 ES (no 2027 page found); the 2026 ES release states the NACS J3400-style port. Compared 2026 vs 2027, US only.

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: The 2027 ES carries the 2026 ES hardware (native NACS); the 2026 ES charged at a Tesla Supercharger (InsideEVs test) and is listed as Supercharger-compatible.
